items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Bill Miller was in that band with Mildred and I.

ctx.x: Then I'd go back and go back to the Sands or that same five pieces with Bill Miller, we did a benefit with Sinatra in Los Angeles . Just six men. And he liked it. So he said, that's what I'm going to -- that's what we'll use that's a great idea. So we went to the Fontainebleau, yeah, first we went to the Fontainebleau and in Florida with that group. That's all he used behind him, just six of us, you know, it was like -- it was really a shocking revelation. See him come out. Cause, he had -- one of his ideas was…
